ContinuousMap.curry.type:
@ContinuousMap.curry.{u_1, u_2,
    u_3} : {X : Type u_1} →
  {Y : Type u_2} →
    {Z : Type u_3} →
      [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u_1} X] →
        [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace.{u_2} Y] →
          [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace.{u_3} Z] →
            @ContinuousMap.{max u_2 u_1, u_3} (Prod.{u_1, u_2} X Y) Z
                (@instTopologicalSpaceProd.{u_1, u_2} X Y inst inst_1) inst_2 →
              @ContinuousMap.{u_1, max u_3 u_2} X (@ContinuousMap.{u_2, u_3} Y Z inst_1 inst_2) inst
                (@ContinuousMap.compactOpen.{u_2, u_3} Y Z inst_1 inst_2)

ContinuousMap.uncurry.type:
@ContinuousMap.uncurry.{u_1, u_2,
    u_3} : {X : Type u_1} →
  {Y : Type u_2} →
    {Z : Type u_3} →
      [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u_1} X] →
        [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace.{u_2} Y] →
          [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace.{u_3} Z] →
            [@LocallyCompactSpace.{u_2} Y inst_1] →
              @ContinuousMap.{u_1, max u_3 u_2} X (@ContinuousMap.{u_2, u_3} Y Z inst_1 inst_2) inst
                  (@ContinuousMap.compactOpen.{u_2, u_3} Y Z inst_1 inst_2) →
                @ContinuousMap.{max u_2 u_1, u_3} (Prod.{u_1, u_2} X Y) Z
                  (@instTopologicalSpaceProd.{u_1, u_2} X Y inst inst_1) inst_2

perfectlyNormalSpace_iff_forall_isClosed.type:
@perfectlyNormalSpace_iff_forall_isClosed_preimage_zero.{u_1} : ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u_1} X],
  Iff (@PerfectlyNormalSpace.{u_1} X inst)
    (∀ (s : Set.{u_1} X),
      @IsClosed.{u_1} X inst s →
        ∃ f,
          And
            (@Eq.{u_1 + 1} (Set.{u_1} X) s
              (@Set.preimage.{u_1, 0} X Real
                (@DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, 1}
                  (@ContinuousMap.{u_1, 0} X Real inst
                    (@UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace.{0} Real
                      (@PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace.{0} Real Real.pseudoMetricSpace)))
                  X (fun x => Real)
                  (@ContinuousMap.instFunLike.{u_1, 0} X Real inst
                    (@UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace.{0} Real
                      (@PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace.{0} Real Real.pseudoMetricSpace)))
                  f)
                (@singleton.{0, 0} Real (Set.{0} Real) (@Set.instSingletonSet.{0} Real)
                  (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 0) (@Zero.toOfNat0.{0} Real Real.instZero)))))
            (∀ (x : X),
              @Membership.mem.{0, 0} Real (Set.{0} Real) (@Set.instMembership.{0} Real)
                (@Set.Icc.{0} Real Real.instPreorder
                  (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 0) (@Zero.toOfNat0.{0} Real Real.instZero))
                  (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 1) (@One.toOfNat1.{0} Real Real.instOne)))
                (@DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, 1}
                  (@ContinuousMap.{u_1, 0} X Real inst
                    (@UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace.{0} Real
                      (@PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace.{0} Real Real.pseudoMetricSpace)))
                  X (fun x => Real)
                  (@ContinuousMap.instFunLike.{u_1, 0} X Real inst
                    (@UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace.{0} Real
                      (@PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace.{0} Real Real.pseudoMetricSpace)))
                  f x)))
